title: frame-0 requirements
description: episodes/<slug>/<EPID>/_context/frame0-requirements.json — written at 04f, consumed at 04f2. The handoff that makes each still DERIVABLE from its clip prompt rather than guessed alongside it. Validated by LTXV-S001/S002/S003.

touched_objects.description: EVERY object a character contacts, lifts, leans on, reaches for, or treats as a focal object. i2v never invents objects — an omission here is how a clip ends up reaching for a prop that does not exist in its own first frame. Every entry must also appear as a key in props_at_rest and be named in the clip prose.

characters.description: Must equal the visible cast in blocking.json for this clip (LTXV-S003).

props_at_rest.description: Keyed by the same object name used in touched_objects. Value is the settled frame-0 state — never mid-motion.

first_action_performable.description: Asserting this means the clip's opening action was actually checked as physically beginnable from that frozen instant. It is not a formality: a still showing a door already open cannot support a clip that knocks on it. If it is not true, fix the still or the blocking — never advance with false.

continues_from.description: The immediately preceding clip id, or null for the episode's first clip. Drives LTXV-S004.
